An Exposition of the Jacobite Liturgy
Commentary on the Eucharist

bibl.author: Moses bar Kipho — ܡܘܫܐ ܒܪ ܟܐܦܐ

noteGrp.note: A Syriac exposition of the Eucharistic liturgy attributed to Moses bar Kipho. The commentary explains the rites of the liturgy and, in its anaphoral section, comments on the Syriac Liturgy of St. James. Connolly and Codrington note that Moses draws extensively on George, bishop of the Arab tribes, and that the work in turn was incorporated extensively into the later liturgical commentary of Dionysius bar Salibi.
